title: A lesson on arch bridges
brief: One 45-minute hands-on lesson where students build paper arches and test how much weight they hold, to go with a textbook chapter on arch bridges.

answers.lesson_scope: Compression in arches, using paper and coins. Grade 6 class of about 25. Goes with the chapter Arches in How Bridges Stand Up.
